messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "1 to 4 days: most people feel full benefit"
set: ["1 to 4 days: most people feel full benefit", "it may take 4 weeks or longer before you feel the full benefit", "may take 1 to 4 days to reach its full effect", "it may take 4 to 6 weeks to get the full benefit of a dose", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects", "most people are told to eat more potassium", "5 weeks or longer for full benefit in OCD", "most people are told not to eat less potassium", "about 4 days: acid-lowering effect reaches maximum with once-daily dosing", "take for 4 to 6 weeks before feeling full effects", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "most ulcers heal within 4 weeks of treatment", "prevent dialing full dose after 4 weekly doses", "requires 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for full effect to build up", "full effect for depression may take 4 weeks or longer", "4 to 6 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
